notes: Added Storage location to each real node's management page, backed by persistent Node API settings rather than a Manager-only label.
Bundled Rip Node API v0.2.8 validates that the selected path is absolute, exists and is writable, and blocks storage changes during an active rip.
The chosen output directory survives Manager and Node API updates without storing SSH credentials.
Removed the built-in Simulator from the Output Shares popup because it has no real SMB output share.
The v0.18.6 empty scanner and label-status fixes are preserved; installations remain manual-only.
